leadText:
Mount Hideaway (Japanese: ミヤーザーキ山 Mount Miyāzāki) is an -exclusive mountain located near Pallet Town. The rugged area is home to unusually large . Something in the soil causes the Onix to grow to gigantic proportions. 

It is also a area for Kanto Elite Four member Bruno. While training for the Indigo Plateau Conference, and decided to find him and seek his advice on training in To Master the Onixpected!.
